title: Constructing interval variables via faceted Rasch measurement and multitask deep learning: a hate speech application
measurement_description: The paper measures hate speech directed at various identity groups, including religious groups. It develops a method to place social media comments on a continuous interval spectrum, ranging from counterspeech to genocidal hate speech, based on ordinal ratings of multiple constituent components. One of the primary identity categories for which hate speech is measured is religion.
findings: The paper's primary findings relate to its novel methodology for measuring hate speech, which significantly outperforms benchmarks like Google Jigsaw's Perspective API. While religion is a key category of identity-based hate speech evaluated, the paper does not present specific findings on model performance for religious hate speech versus other categories. The methodology was successful in creating a continuous, debiased scale for hate speech that can be applied to comments targeting religious groups, among others.
